name: Snaprint
description: Snaprint turns xerox/photocopy shops into 24/7 self-service print kiosks. Students and customers scan a QR code, upload a document, pay, and collect the print — no queue, no shop owner needed to operate it.

product.name: Snaprint S1
product.description: Connects to any existing printer (Canon, HP, Epson, Brother). Customers scan a QR code, upload a document, pay, and collect the print without staff present.
